entries.claim: The scientific lineage is committed through UFA-JEV-BP-0024 in a verified MMR.
entries.allowed_wording: The repository verifier reconstructs the ordered breakpoint MMR through BP-0024.
entries.forbidden_stronger_wording: Do not equate MMR inclusion with truth or correctness.

entries.claim: Post-confirmatory secondary statistics were computed from frozen E1-E3 outputs without mutating original claims.
entries.allowed_wording: Secondary uncertainty/effect summaries supplement, but do not replace, the confirmatory decisions.
entries.forbidden_stronger_wording: Do not recast secondary analyses as preregistered confirmatory endpoints.
